answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: each new agent's earnings flow like a river into a locked pool that releases only after, say, 26 epochs of continued graded work. An identity that goes silent or is caught colluding forfeits its unvested balance. A fake identity is an island the attacker must keep alive alone, paying compute for fresh answers every epoch while its reward sits locked, so a thousand clones become a reef of stranded capital rather than instant profit.
